description: Only what nothing else updates: extensions and skins pinned to a release tag in Dockerfile-mediawiki (REL1_46 and main clones already follow their branch on the weekly rebuild), MediaWiki core (the 1.46.x tarball), the PHP extensions built from GitHub tags because PECL went down during an urgent rebuild (phpredis, APCu, LuaSandbox, wikidiff2), the Falco images, and MariaDB and Redis, which are pinned by digest so a deploy only restarts them when a bump is merged. Other images stay managed by hand.

packageRules.description: Stay on the MariaDB 11.8 LTS series. A move to a newer series is a database upgrade to plan, not a routine bump.
